How old is Grayson Allen?

Grayson Allen is 30 years old.

Grayson Allen was born in Jacksonville, Florida.

Grayson Allen was born on October 8, 1995.

How tall is Grayson Allen?

Grayson Allen is 6-3 (190 cm) tall.

How much does Grayson Allen weigh?

Grayson Allen weighs 198 lbs (89 kg).

Is Grayson Allen in the Hall of Fame?

Grayson Allen is not in the Hall of Fame.

When was Grayson Allen drafted?

Grayson Allen was drafted by Utah Jazz, 1st round (21st pick, 21st overall), 2018 NBA Draft.

What position does Grayson Allen play?

Shooting Guard.

What is Grayson Allen's net worth?

Grayson Allen has made at least $60,876,898 playing professional basketball.

Grayson Allen made $16,875,000 in 2026.

Grayson Allen has won 0 championships.

What is Grayson Allen's Instagram account?

Grayson Allen is on Instagram at graysonjallen.

What schools did Grayson Allen attend?

Grayson Allen attended Providence School in Jacksonville, Florida and Duke.

What are Grayson Allen's nicknames?

G-money, Deebo are nicknames for Grayson Allen.
